# Disagreement Log — GTH_113

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 113
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 113 | "by watching for it" | "by expectation" | "by looking for it" | *paraterēsis*: watching/observing vs. expectation |
| 2 | 113 | "spread out upon the earth" | "spread out over the earth" | "spread out across the earth" | Preposition: upon vs. over vs. across |
| 3 | 113 | "people do not see it" | "people do not see it" | "people just don't see it" | PNEUMA adds "just" for ironic emphasis |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "by watching for it" (*paraterēsis* as active observing for signs), "upon the earth" (literal *hijm pkah*), and "people do not see it" (unadorned statement of fact).
